name: opencli-plugin-huawei-chaspark
description: Huawei's 黄大年茶思屋 academic community (chaspark.com) — `search` returns the top N most relevant items (title, type, author, date, views, summary, item_id, detail_url) from the chaspark full-text search; `read` fetches one item's full content by its detail URL. Requires a logged-in Huawei session via the OpenCLI Browser Bridge.
